condition_text: Stage QUALIFIED–FIRST_TRADE, hedger or speculator segment exposed to a volatility trigger (realized >3σ, scarcity alert, or forecast peak ≤72h) in its ISO; no triggered sequence in last 14d
action: Launch volatility sequence: T0 email with their hub chart + illustrative DAILY_PEAK replay of the event, compliance-approved before send

condition_text: Funded ≥21 days ago, no qualifying trade (≥10 contracts, non-self-match)
action: Head of GTM call with risk/treasury owner: diagnose the blocker (hedge policy, risk limits, ops/API) and log a reason code

condition_text: KYC submitted >5 days ago and not approved (open kyc_info_requested loop)
action: Chase the named missing KYC doc with its owner; offer a 15-min call with their compliance lead; escalate to Compliance at day 8

condition_text: Agreement signed >3 days ago, kyc_submitted not logged
action: Send prefilled KYC packet (entity docs, LEI, authorized traders, UBO) and book a 20-min guided KYC session

condition_text: KYC approved >5 days ago, collateral deposit not cleared
action: Send funding steps + first-hedge sizing: stated MW × 16 on-peak hours → DAILY_PEAK contract count and collateral needed

condition_text: PROP or FUND account funded >5 days ago with no api_key_created event
action: API onboarding: issue keys, sandbox-certify order/cancel/replace flow, review pre-trade risk limits with their dev lead

condition_text: Funded >7 days ago, no qualifying trade
action: Live walkthrough: replay last 7 days at their ISO hub and size a DAILY_PEAK hedge against stated load or output; SE joins

condition_text: First qualifying trade >10 days ago, no second distinct trading day
action: Post-trade debrief: fill vs realized hub index on their exposure; propose a standing weekly routine (e.g., Monday peak ladder)

condition_text: Distinct trading days in trailing 30 down ≥50% vs prior 30
action: Churn-risk check-in: show trailing vs prior 30d activity and spreads at their hub; log reason code (limits, P&L, desk, liquidity)

condition_text: Active/Expanding/At-Risk account exposed to a volatility trigger in its ISO (Active accounts get a note, not a sequence)
action: Send compliance-approved market note: hub, peak $/MWh, spike hours, 5-day forward look; no sequence for Active accounts

condition_text: Top-20 account by 20-td ADV (ex-LP line) with no QBR logged in last 90 days
action: Schedule QBR from Account 360: ADV trend, tenor/ISO use, spread experience, 2 growth plays; Head of GTM joins for top-5

condition_text: Active ≥60 days, trades one ISO or one tenor, holds assets/load in another live ISO
action: Expansion play: 2nd ISO where they hold assets/load, or HOURLY contracts for ramp/shape hours, sized from their exposure

condition_text: Qualified >10 days, participant agreement not sent
action: Send participant agreement + 15-min onboarding preview: KYC checklist, collateral flow, sample DAILY_PEAK ticket at their hub

condition_text: Target account with propensity score in top decile and no logged touch
action: First call + 1-page exposure brief: hub price/spike history, peak vs off-peak spread, which short-dated tenor maps to their risk

condition_text: Funded, zero trades in trailing 30 days, funded ≥30 days
action: Win-back nurture: forward-risk note before the next forecast peak at their hub + walkthrough offer; AE calls on reply
Review in Account 360: confirm ISO, hub, MW and side of exposure; set a dated next step in CRM (no open task >5 business days)
